core_commands.claim: high-frequency families occupy a low-dimensional concrete-face subset
context and hand both predict exact choice beyond a family baseline, without robust context>hand dominance
uniform all-seen exact reuse is predictive but insufficient to reproduce exact-form concentration
the opposite half of the true bifolio predicts concrete face choice beyond context+hand and better than wrong-bifolio halves
line-composition-preserving ordering excess remains within lines but not across line boundaries

interpretation_ceiling: These tests support a constrained generative account and show that substantial structure can be modeled without plaintext semantics. They do not by themselves prove that the historical production process was mechanical, nonsemantic, or unique.

transcription_robustness.scope: one alternate EVA transcription of the same manuscript; not universal transcription validation
